---
title: Vendor Leaderboard
description: Ranked vendor performance scores across 7 dimensions with levels from Bronze to Diamond, plus a per-vendor scorecard with improvement tips and history.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Performance → **Leaderboard** (`/vendor-scores`)

Every vendor gets a performance score out of 100, built from **7 dimensions**, and a level (**Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond**). Scores refresh nightly.

## What the screen shows

### Level cards

Five cards across the top show how many vendors are at each level: **Diamond, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze**.

### Leaderboard table

Above the table: total vendor count and the average score. Results are paginated (50 per page).

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| # | Rank by score. |
| Vendor | Vendor name and shop name. |
| City | Vendor city. |
| Score | Overall score (0–100). |
| Level | Level badge (Bronze → Diamond). |
| Completion | Completion rate score. |
| SLA | SLA compliance score. |
| Reviews | Customer reviews score. |
| Volume | Number of orders counted. |

## Filters & search

- **Search** — vendor name, phone or shop.
- **Level chips** — All, Diamond, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze.

## Actions

- **Recompute All** (top right) — recalculates scores for all vendors now instead of waiting for the nightly refresh.
- **Click a row** — opens the vendor's scorecard.

## Vendor scorecard

`/vendor-scores/<vendor-id>` shows one vendor's detail:

| Section | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| Header | Vendor name, shop · city, and a **Recompute** button for just this vendor. |
| Score ring | Overall score, level badge, points needed for the next level (e.g. "11 pts to Diamond") with a progress bar, and the **volume multiplier** with completed / eligible order counts. |
| Dimension cards | The 7 dimension scores: **Completion Rate, Requote Behavior, SLA Compliance, Customer Reviews, Reliability, Pricing Accuracy, Area Performance**. |
| How to improve | Prioritised tips (e.g. *high*) explaining what to fix, with the current value and the target (e.g. requote rate current vs. target "Under 15%"). |
| Score history | Trend of recent scores. |
| Level progression | Timeline of level changes with dates. |

<Callout kind="info">
The volume multiplier adjusts the score based on the vendor's completed vs. eligible order volume, so a handful of good results on very few orders does not outrank a consistently busy vendor.
</Callout>

<Callout kind="tip">
Share the **How to improve** tips with vendors during performance calls — they name the exact metric and target to work on.
</Callout>
